text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While heading towards the training room—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Whenever you have some free time, I'd be delighted if you'd join me for an outdoor tea ceremony again~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, feel free to call upon
this King anytime!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll gladly take you up on that.
Well then, excuse me~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what kind of Japanese sweets will be served next?
Fufu, I can't wait..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—King-san!
Just the person I was looking for.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, McQueen!
Do you have business with the King?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I was wondering if you might like to join me for a dessert buffet at a restaurant favored by the Mejiro family sometime.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That sounds lovely!
It'll be a nice way to catch your breath, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
They'll be offering seasonal limited-edition cakes as well,
so please look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will contact you later, then—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Now I have a post-training treat to look forward to...♪

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: âAh, King spotted~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, is it you two this time?

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, let's all have a sweets party
after school tomorrow, okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I don't mind at all!
After all, King is more generous than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: Yay~, as expected of King~♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...?
Do you desire King's presence as well?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped, I suppose. Fine, bring on
any dessert or sweet you've got—!
choice_data_list: Aren't you having a bit too much sugar?
Aren't you having too much sugar?
You're loved by everyone, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped, I suppose. Fine, bring on
any dessert or sweet you've got—!
choice_data_list: Aren't you having a bit too much sugar?
Aren't you having too much sugar?
You're loved by everyone, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Do you honestly believe someone as exceptional as King would neglect her conditioning and consume excess sugar...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Heh, that's completely out of the question.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "...Well, I suppose I could at least hear out what you have to say."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Next time, please invite me to something with a few less calories...!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...?
Is that really so...?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"King's overwhelming virtue must simply be
irresistible to so many hearts!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Don't be shy either—feel free to invite me for tea anytime!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Just be sure to have some sweet snacks ready.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oooohohohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"According to what I heard later, people often invite King Halo along
because she's approachable and has a sweet tooth."
